About.title: A library to explore, compare and understand quantum algorithms.
About.description: Quantum Algorithm Library was developed to gather structured information about quantum algorithms, making it easier to study, compare and choose the most suitable solution for different computational problems.
About.objectiveParagraph1: The main objective of the platform is to make knowledge about quantum algorithms more accessible, organized and applicable. Instead of presenting only a technical list, the system structures each algorithm with information such as category, complexity, applications, advantages and limitations.
About.objectiveParagraph2: This helps students, researchers and professionals better understand when an algorithm can be used, which problems it solves and which criteria should be considered before choosing it.
About.audienceText: The platform is designed for students, professors, researchers, developers and teams interested in quantum computing, especially those who need to consult algorithms in a clear, fast and comparable way.
About.howText: Algorithms are organized in a navigable library. Users can explore records, compare characteristics between solutions and use guided search to find options better aligned with the analyzed problem.
About.featureLibraryText: Organized consultation by algorithms, categories and characteristics.
About.featureCompareText: Side-by-side analysis to support decisions and technical studies.
About.featureGuidedText: Recommendation guided by problem type and user needs.
About.featureAdminText: Algorithm creation and updates through an internal interface.
About.futureTitle: An evolving base for quantum computing studies
About.futureText: The proposal is for the platform to continuously grow, receiving new algorithms, user experience improvements, multilingual support and intelligent recommendation resources.
